Signature Menu

Crafted with intention.

— Signature —
Pistachio Latte
Silky espresso with house-made pistachio cream and perfectly textured milk. Our most beloved creation. Order once, come back forever.
— Signature —
Matcha Latte
Ceremonial-grade matcha whisked to a vivid green, paired with steamed oat milk. Calm energy. Beautiful colour. Perfect balance.
— Specialty —
Espresso Orange
Bold Italian-inspired pairing — bright cold-pressed orange and deep espresso. Unexpectedly perfect. A Muse original.
— Seasonal —
Muse Fizz
A sparkling house creation that changes with the season. Always surprising, always beautiful, always worth photographing.

Patisserie

Every day,
a new masterpiece.

Our pastry counter is a daily composition. Mousse cakes, cream puffs, strawberry meringues, Snickers mousses, opera cakes, and seasonal creations — all made in-house with quality ingredients and an eye for beauty.

Come in the morning, before they disappear.

The Space

Designed to
slow you down.

Deep green velvet chairs, warm golden light, original artwork on every wall, and a hanging botanical installation. This is a café that feels like a home you never want to leave.

Our Story

Where coffee, art,
and conversation
come together.

Muse was born from a simple belief: that a café should be more than a place to drink coffee. It should be a place to feel something. To slow down. To find your next idea, your next connection, your next favourite flavour.

Nestled in a beautiful historic building on Hlavná Street — the heart of Košice — we serve every guest with warmth, quality, and intention. Every bean freshly roasted. Every cake made by hand.
